contract.label: Radio group
contract.summary: A set of mutually-exclusive options: a RadioGroup coordinates its RadioGroupItems.
contract.purpose: Choose exactly one option from a short visible set. Each item rests on the same opaque face as a `checkbox` — `outline-surface` — so an unselected ring stays visible on a tinted row or the `muted` page body, and dark keeps the `input` lift every other field has.
useWhen: Two to about six mutually exclusive options that should all be visible at once, so the user can compare them before choosing.
Each option needs a line of description — lay the items out as cards.
dontUseWhen: More options than fit comfortably in view — that is `select`.
Several options can be chosen — that is `checkbox`.
Two states switched in place in a toolbar — that is `toggle-group` with a single value.

parts.name: RadioGroup
parts.description: Root coordinating selection across its items.

parts.name: RadioGroupItem
parts.description: A single circular radio with a checked-dot indicator.

requires: A label on every item, wired through `label` so the text selects it, and an accessible name on the group — `aria-labelledby` pointing at its heading, or `aria-label`.
`aria-invalid` on the items when a required choice is missing, paired with a `FieldError`.
forbids: Re-tinting an item's resting face with a `bg-*` class. It is opaque in light and the `input` lift in dark on every surface, with no `surface` prop to set.
A single radio on its own — one yes/no is a `checkbox`.
rules: **The face is opaque by default, on every surface.** An unselected item paints `outline-surface` — white in light, the `input/30` lift in dark — so it reads on a tinted card option, a selected row and the `muted` page body without any prop. There is no `surface="page"`: a 16px ring has nothing but its edge to read by, so it never rests transparent.

behavior.error: A required group with no selection marks its items `aria-invalid` and says so in an inline `FieldError` under the group — never a blocked submit with no message.

requirements: The group is one tab stop; arrow keys move the selection between items.
Every item has an accessible name from its label, and the group has one of its own.

examples: `<RadioGroup defaultValue="day" aria-label="Interval"><Label className="flex items-center gap-2"><RadioGroupItem value="day" /> Day</Label>…</RadioGroup>`
antiPatterns: A group with no accessible name, so a screen reader announces three unrelated radios.
An item given `bg-background` or `bg-card` to show on a tinted row — the default face already does, and in dark `background` would sink it below the cards beside it.
